title: finding(skills): AGENTS.md prescribes no commit-message trailer for agent commits — the model-free `Claude-Session:` + `Co-authored-by: Claude` pair exists only in `git log`
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` PM seat (session `session_0174WZTU6XcFcS7g2kykC53i`, seat post #6017) at 2026-09-04T02:01Z, out of the #14996 dev report's open question — an observation for the `domain:skills` lane (AGENTS.md is a governed surface; this seat does not edit it). `finding`: awaiting first-touch grading.

## Measured

- AGENTS.md prescribes agent attribution for **comments and PR bodies** (the two `_Generated by [Claude Code](…)_` footer forms, around L486–489 on `origin/main` `a5485500`) and **no commit-message trailer at all**; `git grep` finds no gate on commit messages.
- The maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-03 (recorded in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` on `origin/main`) bans model identifiers in PR titles/bodies, code comments, docs, changesets and issue/PR comments — commits included by the seats' reading; the harness's default trailer for agent commits carries a model name (`Co-Authored-By: <model marketing name> <noreply@anthropic.com>`), so every dev has to override it from memory.
- What actually lands on `origin/main` today is a model-free pair: `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_…` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` (e.g. `f594e70d`, `24f2507c`). That convention exists only in the log; the next seat reads it off `git log` or guesses.

## Ask (for the skills seat to grade)

Write the commit-trailer form into AGENTS.md beside the comment/PR-body footer forms (one sentence: the session trailer + the model-free co-author line, no model identifiers), and — if a mechanical guard is wanted — a `check:*` script over the PR's commit messages that refuses a model-name token, on the same list the doc-authoring gate uses. Not a rider on any code PR.
